interface.shortDescription: Thread intent into evidence-backed Codex goals.
interface.longDescription: Threadex is a thin Codex harness for clarifying material ambiguity, drafting verifiable requirements, preparing outcome-first prompts with explicit constraints and completion evidence for Codex's built-in /goal feature, auditing agent results, and preserving reusable learnings.
defaultPrompt: Use Threadex to resolve material ambiguity and prepare an evidence-checkable prompt for Codex /goal.
Use Threadex to write verifiable requirements while preserving the values and checks I supplied.
Use Threadex to map every requirement to current evidence and determine whether this result is complete.
